definitions.rationale: This conditional equation defines the sufficient-stock branch of the named carrotContract summary.
definitions.text:
rule carrotContract(NUMBER, NEED, REMAINING)
    => result(NUMBER +Int NEED, REMAINING -Int NEED)
    requires NEED <=Int REMAINING

definitions.rationale: This conditional equation defines the insufficient-stock branch of the named carrotContract summary.
definitions.text:
rule carrotContract(NUMBER, NEED, REMAINING)
    => result(NUMBER +Int REMAINING, 0)
    requires REMAINING <Int NEED

definitions.rationale: This equation expands the named validInput predicate into the prompt's three integer range constraints.
definitions.text:
rule validInput(NUMBER, NEED, REMAINING)
    => (0 <=Int NUMBER andBool NUMBER <=Int 1000)
       andBool (0 <=Int NEED andBool NEED <=Int 1000)
       andBool (0 <=Int REMAINING andBool REMAINING <=Int 1000)
